name: Firebase (Auth + Cloud Firestore)
description: Firebase Authentication, Cloud Firestore named database conventions, declarative firestore.rules baseline, and emulator security rules testing.
verification_commands: npm run test:rules  # required when firestore.rules or security rules tests change (or npx -y firebase-tools@latest emulators:exec ...)

evaluators.name: Firebase Auth & Firestore Security Rules Evaluator
evaluators.scope: Tenant isolation, RBAC create/update invariants, hasOnly field allowlists, quota math, named database ID consistency, and bounded queries.

single_concurrency_locks: Firebase Firestore Emulator: Only 1 subagent at a time may run `npm run test:rules` or `firebase emulators:exec` to prevent local port collisions.
pr_checklist: Any `firestore.rules` modifications were delegated to `firestore-rules-author`, audited with `firestore-security-auditor`, and verified in the Firestore Emulator
agents_md_rules: **Firebase & Firestore Rules:** Follow [`.agents/skills/firebase-platform/SKILL.md`](.agents/skills/firebase-platform/SKILL.md) and [`.agents/skills/firestore-security-auditor/SKILL.md`](.agents/skills/firestore-security-auditor/SKILL.md). Always delegate `firestore.rules` authoring to the `firestore-rules-author` subagent.

steps.name: Run Firestore security rules suite if configured
steps.run: if [ -f package.json ] && grep -q '"test:rules"' package.json; then if [ -f package-lock.json ]; then npm ci; else npm install; fi && npm run test:rules; else echo 'No package.json test:rules script configured yet; skipping emulator rules suite'; fi
